description: Redux reducer module for managing file-related state in Mattermost, including files, search results, file IDs by post, file public links, and rejected files.

methods.name: files
methods.description: Reducer handling file entities, including receiving, removing, and bookmarking files.

methods.name: filesFromSearch
methods.description: Reducer for managing files returned from search.

methods.name: storeAllFilesForPost
methods.description: Helper to process embedded files in posts and store associated files.

methods.name: storeFilesForPost
methods.description: Stores files associated with a specific post.

methods.name: fileIdsByPostId
methods.description: Reducer managing mapping of post IDs to file IDs.

methods.name: storeFilesIdsForPost
methods.description: Helper to store file IDs for a post.

methods.name: filePublicLink
methods.description: Reducer managing public link for a file.

methods.name: rejectedFiles
methods.description: Reducer tracking files that failed to download.
